################################################################################
# Project config for Tizen-Base-Toolchain
#
# RE contacts:
#
#
# vim: set syntax=spec:
################################################################################

Patterntype: rpm-md comps
Release: <CI_CNT>.<B_CNT>
Support: build
Support: build-compare build-mkbaselibs
# Support: rpmlint-mini rpmlint-tizen

# new cycle handling (gbs version >= 0.25.29)
BuildFlags: genmetaalgo:1

############################# conflicts resolution #############################

Prefer: util-linux
Prefer: toybox
Prefer: mono-wcf
Prefer: monodoc
Prefer: mono-extras
Prefer: mono-web
Prefer: mono-data
Prefer: mono-mvc
Prefer: mono-winforms
Prefer: mono-data-sqlite

# Set a preference for ambiguous libs to use *-64bit libs
#     *-64bit libs on 32bit build environment are required for .Net build (e.g., coreclr, corefx)
#     But when building 64bit target, they could make 'have choice' error with original libs in 64bit repository.
#     e.g., libstdc++ and libstdc++-64bit provides same libs. It's ambiguous to choose appropriate one.
#     Owner : Jiyoung Yun (jy910.yun@samsung.com)
#     libopenssl* : Dongsun Lee (ds73.lee@samsung.com), Dariusz Michaluk (d.michaluk@samsung.com)
Prefer: libgcc libstdc++ libunwind libuuid zlib libopenssl libopenssl11 libopenssl3
Prefer: lldb

############################# base definition ###############################

# %release_name and %tizen_full_version are used in platform/upstream/tizen-release

Macros:
%release_name Tizen11.0/Unified

%tizen_version_major 11
%tizen_version_minor 0
%tizen_version_patch 0

%tizen_version %{tizen_version_major}.%{tizen_version_minor}
%tizen_full_version %{tizen_version}.%{tizen_version_patch}
%tizen %tizen_version
%vendor tizen
%_vendor tizen
%_with_tizen 1

%opensuse_bs 1
%_default_patch_fuzz   2

%_binary_payload w5T.xzdio
:Macros

#### %%__spec_check_pre exit 0
#### %%run_check_section 0

# skip %%check section
Macros:
# skip package list
%_skip_check_packages autogen bison boost expat findutils flex fribidi glibc \\\
gmp gn golang grep libgc libgcrypt libogg libsigc++ libvorbis libxml2 libzio \\\
m4 nspr openssl openssl1.1 perl-Devel-Symdump perl-gettext perl-Pod-Coverage \\\
perl-Test-Pod perl-Test-Pod-Coverage perl-TimeDate procps-ng python3-mako \\\
python3-mock python3-ply python-funcsigs python-mako python-mock python-ply \\\
setup zlib openssl3 autoconf libxcrypt

%__spec_check_pre \
for name in %_skip_check_packages \
do \
    if [ "$name" = "%{name}" ]; then \
        exit 0 \
    fi \
done \
%{___build_pre} \
%{nil}

:Macros

############################# build config #####################################

########## compilers and utils ##########

%ifarch armv7l aarch64
Macros:
%_with_mlgo 1
%mlgo_build_jobs 6
%mlgo_verify_configure_only 0
:Macros
%endif

%ifarch armv7l armv7hl
Macros:
%___optflags_toolchain_gcc --param=ssp-buffer-size=4
:Macros
%endif
%ifarch aarch64 riscv64
Macros:
%___optflags_toolchain_gcc -feliminate-unused-debug-types
:Macros
%endif
%ifarch i686 x86_64
Macros:
%___optflags_toolchain_gcc --param=ssp-buffer-size=4 -feliminate-unused-debug-types
%___optflags_toolchain_clang -momit-leaf-frame-pointer %{?_with_mlgo:-mllvm=-regalloc-enable-advisor=release -mllvm=-enable-ml-inliner=release}
:Macros
%endif

Macros:
# clang utils
%__ar_clang llvm-ar
%__ranlib_clang llvm-ranlib
%__cc_clang %{_host}-clang
%__cxx_clang %{_host}-clang++
%__optflags_toolchain_clang -Os -fstack-protector -Wno-unused-command-line-argument -Wno-error=unused-but-set-variable -Wno-error=unused-command-line-argument %{?___optflags_toolchain_clang:%{___optflags_toolchain_clang}}

# gcc utils
%__ar_gcc gcc-ar
%__ranlib_gcc gcc-ranlib
%__cc_gcc %{_host}-gcc
%__cxx_gcc %{_host}-g++
%__optflags_toolchain_gcc -O2 -fno-inline-functions -fstack-protector-strong %{?___optflags_toolchain_gcc:%{___optflags_toolchain_gcc}}

%_toolchain %{?_toolchain_override}%{!?_toolchain_override:clang}
%toolchain_is() %((echo "%_toolchain" | %{__grep} -qE "%{1}") && echo 1 || echo 0)

%__ar %{expand:%%{__ar_%{_toolchain}}}
%__ranlib %{expand:%%{__ranlib_%{_toolchain}}}
%__cc %{expand:%%{__cc_%{_toolchain}}}
%__cxx %{expand:%%{__cxx_%{_toolchain}}}
%__optflags_toolchain %{expand:%%{__optflags_toolchain_%{_toolchain}}}

%prep %%prep\
export AR=%{__ar} RANLIB=%{__ranlib};\
%{nil}

%build %%build\
export AR=%{__ar} RANLIB=%{__ranlib};\
export CC=%{__cc} CXX=%{__cxx};\
%{nil}

%install %{?_enable_debug_packages:%{?buildsubdir:%{debug_package}}}\
%%install\
export AR=%{__ar} RANLIB=%{__ranlib};\
export CC=%{__cc} CXX=%{__cxx};\
%{nil}
:Macros

########## targets ##########

%ifarch i586
Target: i686-tizen-linux
%endif

%ifarch armv7hl
Target: armv7hl-tizen-linux
%endif

%ifarch armv7l
Target: armv7l-tizen-linux
%endif

%ifarch aarch64
Target: aarch64-tizen-linux
%endif

%ifarch riscv64
Target: riscv64-tizen-linux
%endif

########## cross build ##########

%define build_hostarch x86_64
Macros:
%build_hostarch x86_64
:Macros

%ifarch riscv64 %arm armv7l armv7hl aarch64
Hostarch: x86_64
# cross build support for the build hosts
Preinstall: qemu-linux-user-%{build_hostarch}-cross
Runscripts: qemu-linux-user-%{build_hostarch}-cross
Keep: qemu-linux-user-%{build_hostarch}-cross
Macros:
%qemu_user_space_build 1
:Macros
%endif

%ifarch armv7l
Preinstall: qemu-accel-%{build_hostarch}-armv7l
Runscripts: qemu-accel-%{build_hostarch}-armv7l
Preinstall: clang-accel-%{build_hostarch}-armv7l
Runscripts: clang-accel-%{build_hostarch}-armv7l
Preinstall: libmount libblkid libuuid
%endif

%ifarch armv7hl
Preinstall: qemu-accel-%{build_hostarch}-armv7hl
Runscripts: qemu-accel-%{build_hostarch}-armv7hl
Preinstall: clang-accel-%{build_hostarch}-armv7hl
Runscripts: clang-accel-%{build_hostarch}-armv7hl
Preinstall: libmount libblkid libuuid
%endif

%ifarch aarch64
Preinstall: qemu-accel-%{build_hostarch}-aarch64
Runscripts: qemu-accel-%{build_hostarch}-aarch64
Preinstall: clang-accel-%{build_hostarch}-aarch64
Runscripts: clang-accel-%{build_hostarch}-aarch64
Preinstall: libmount libblkid libuuid
%endif # aarch64

%ifarch riscv64
Preinstall: qemu-accel-%{build_hostarch}-riscv64
Runscripts: qemu-accel-%{build_hostarch}-riscv64
Preinstall: clang-accel-%{build_hostarch}-riscv64
Runscripts: clang-accel-%{build_hostarch}-riscv64
Preinstall: libmount libblkid libuuid
%endif # riscv64

Substitute: python-accel-armv7l-cross-arm python-accel-%{build_hostarch}-armv7l
Substitute: python-accel-armv7hl-cross-arm python-accel-%{build_hostarch}-armv7hl
Substitute: python-accel-aarch64-cross-aarch64 python-accel-%{build_hostarch}-aarch64
Substitute: python-accel-riscv64-cross-riscv64 python-accel-%{build_hostarch}-riscv64

Substitute: clang-accel-armv7l-cross-arm clang-accel-%{build_hostarch}-armv7l
Substitute: clang-accel-armv7hl-cross-arm clang-accel-%{build_hostarch}-armv7hl
Substitute: clang-accel-aarch64-cross-aarch64 clang-accel-%{build_hostarch}-aarch64
Substitute: clang-accel-riscv64-cross-riscv64 clang-accel-%{build_hostarch}-riscv64

########## exports for different architectures ##########

ExportFilter: \.armv7l\.rpm$ armv7l
ExportFilter: \.armv7hl\.rpm$ armv7hl
ExportFilter: \.aarch64\.rpm$ aarch64
ExportFilter: \.i586\.rpm$ i586
ExportFilter: \.x86_64\.rpm$ x86_64
ExportFilter: \.riscv64\.rpm$ riscv64

########## buildroot config ##########

# Bootstrap stage: Optimal order for bash → dash /bin/sh transition
# Timeline: filesystem → bash (/bin/sh=bash) → setup → dash (/bin/sh=dash)

Preinstall: filesystem
Preinstall: bash
RunScripts: setup
Preinstall: dash
Preinstall: bzip2 coreutils toybox diffutils grep rpm
Preinstall: glibc libacl libattr libxcrypt
Preinstall: libcap
Preinstall: libgcc
Preinstall: libpopt sed tar libarchive-tools zlib
Preinstall: libncurses libreadline
Preinstall: libelf libbz2
Preinstall: liblzma
Preinstall: libopenssl3
Preinstall: nss nspr libfreebl3 libsoftokn3
Preinstall: libmagic
Preinstall: liblua
Preinstall: smack libsmack libxml2 libmagic  libmagic-data
Preinstall: libsqlite
#Preinstall: rpm-security-plugin
Preinstall: util-linux util-linux-su
Preinstall: libzstd1

VMinstall: perl libmount libblkid libext2fs libuuid  grep libpcre util-linux libsmartcols procps-ng

Required: binutils glibc rpm-build libtool

Support: gcc gcc-c++
Support: clang llvm-devel
Support: glibc-locale
Support: perl
Support: hostname
Support: cpio findutils
Support: file findutils zlib bzip2
Support: gzip hostname net-tools
Support: make  patch sed  gawk tar libarchive-tools grep coreutils toybox pkg-config
Support: m4  tzdata
Support: util-linux
Support: less
Support: which  elfutils
Support: update-alternatives
Support: libstdc++-devel
Support: cpp
Support: libatomic
Support: libgomp
Support: libitm
Support: hal-rootstrap-checker
Support: app-rootstrap-checker

Keep: libstdc++-devel
Keep: cpp gcc libstdc++
Keep: pam
Keep: binutils cpp  libmagic-data file findutils gawk gcc  gcc-c++
Keep: gdbm gzip libada libunwind  glibc-devel libpcre xz-lzma-compat
Keep: make  gmp libcap groff cpio
Keep: patch rpm-build  nss nspr elfutils python grep libgcc gcc-c++
Keep: kernel-headers  perl-libs perl
Keep: pkgconfig glib2 tizen-rpm-config
Keep: libmpc libmpfr libppl libgmp libppl_c
Keep: libcloog libppl libgmpxx
Keep: nss-softokn-freebl libmagic libmagic-data
Keep: setup
Keep: update-alternatives
Keep: clang llvm libllvm llvm-devel
Keep: gcc-c++
Keep: libatomic
Keep: libgomp
Keep: libitm

Substitute: gettext gettext-tools

%ifarch x86_64
Substitute: glibc-devel-32bit glibc-devel-32bit glibc-32bit
Substitute: libgcc_s1-32bit libgcc-32bit
%else
Substitute: glibc-devel-32bit
%endif

########## compilation flags ##########
%define __optflags %{__optflags_toolchain} -g2 -gdwarf-4 -pipe -Wall -Wp,-D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=2 -fexceptions -Wformat -Wformat-security -fmessage-length=0 -frecord-gcc-switches

Optflags: armv7l %{__optflags} -march=armv7-a -mtune=cortex-a8 -mlittle-endian -mfpu=neon -mfloat-abi=softfp -mthumb -Wp,-D__SOFTFP__ -D_FILE_OFFSET_BITS=64
Optflags: armv7hl %{__optflags} -march=armv7-a -mtune=cortex-a8 -mlittle-endian -mfpu=neon -mfloat-abi=hard -mthumb -D_FILE_OFFSET_BITS=64
Optflags: aarch64 %{__optflags} -march=armv8-a+fp+simd+crc+crypto -mtune=cortex-a53
Optflags: i686 %{__optflags} -fdiagnostics-color=never -m32 -march=i686 -mtune=i686 -msse4.2 -mfpmath=sse -fasynchronous-unwind-tables -fno-omit-frame-pointer -mstackrealign
Optflags: x86_64 %{__optflags} -fdiagnostics-color=never -m64 -march=nehalem -msse4.2 -mfpmath=sse -fasynchronous-unwind-tables -fno-omit-frame-pointer
Optflags: riscv64 %{__optflags} -mabi=lp64d -march=rv64gc

%ifarch armv7l armv7hl
Macros:
%_ldflags_arch_extra ,-O1,--hash-style=gnu
:Macros
%endif
%ifarch i686
Macros:
%_ldflags_arch_extra ,-z,noseparate-code
:Macros
%endif
Macros:
%build_ldflags -fuse-ld=lld -Wl,-z,relro,--as-needed%{?_ldflags_arch_extra}
:Macros

Prepare Tizen-Base-Toolchain build root for libc++

Two changes to TIZEN/Tizen/Tizen-Base-Toolchain/project_config:

1. Remove the lld default linker (-fuse-ld=lld in build_ldflags). It
   has not passed validation yet, so the next build uses the GNU linker
   as before. It will be submitted again after validation. This reverts
   commit bae4ebdd732e3c01611de2414434d4c5c162763c.

2. Add libc++ to the build root, to build C++ packages with LLVM libc++
   instead of libstdc++:
   - Support: add libc++-devel and libc++abi-devel, so that every build
     root can compile and link C++ code against libc++.
   - Keep: keep libc++, libc++abi and their -devel packages in the
     build root, in the same way as libstdc++ and libstdc++-devel.

libstdc++ stays in the build root. Packages that do not select libc++
keep building with libstdc++ as before, and GCC builds are not changed.
Packages select libc++ in their own spec (build_with_libcxx under the
clang toolchain).

The libc++ packages are built from packaging/libcxx-runtimes.spec in
platform/upstream/llvm. libcxx-runtimes is not in the current
Tizen-Base-Toolchain repository, so the Support entries must only take
effect after libcxx-runtimes has been built and its binaries are
published; otherwise every package in the project becomes unresolvable.

Change-Id: I0403eb61b5c412c7ed53dc6f862c92765ead121f
Signed-off-by: Hao Lin <hao.lin@samsung.com>
